name: React Template
description: Blank React app foundation powered by the Cloudgate npm SDK. Shared authentication, profile/account linking, users, notifications, analytics, appearance, SMTP, media and payments are managed by the package. Generic placeholder pages guide you to the Developers tools to start building.
features: One Example page placeholder with guidance to the Developers tools
Persistent, verified Cloudgate account linking and detach from Profile
Live IdP notifications, read receipts and link actions over native WebSocket
Website analytics and scoped workflow logs
